title: Catnap and chatgpt
features: Universal mostrar que o killler tá perto
script:
-- Rayfield
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "Catnap Hub 😈",
   LoadingTitle = "Sistema de Alerta",
   LoadingSubtitle = "Killer Detect",
   ConfigurationSaving = {Enabled = false}
})

local Tab = Window:CreateTab("Alerta", 4483362458)

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local alertaOn = false

--------------------------------------------------
-- ⚠️ TOGGLE ALERTA
--------------------------------------------------
Tab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Alerta Killer 😈",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Callback = function(v)
      alertaOn = v
   end,
})

--------------------------------------------------
-- 🔎 SISTEMA
--------------------------------------------------
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not alertaOn then return end

    local myRoot = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return end

    for _,plr in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= player and plr.Character then
            local root = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if root then
                local dist = (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude

                if dist < 20 then
                    local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

                    if hum and hum.WalkSpeed > 20 then
                        Rayfield:Notify({
                            Title = "⚠️ PERIGO",
                            Content = "o killer tá perto 😨",
                            Duration = 1
                        })
                    else
                        Rayfield:Notify({
                            Title = "🙂 Seguro",
                            Content = "ufa só é um sobrevivente",
                            Duration = 1
                        })
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

--------------------------------------------------

Rayfield:Notify({
   Title = "Catnap Hub",
   Content = "Alerta carregado 😈",
   Duration = 5
})
